{
  "action_updates": [
    {
      "action_id": "A4",
      "preconditions": [
        {
          "requirement_id": "A4_PRE1",
          "condition": "The cut on the skin pad must be clearly visible to the examiner.",
          "source": "explicit_instruction",
          "source_reference": "Look at the cut on the skin pad.",
          "requires_expert_review": false,
          "vqa_question": "Is the cut on the skin pad clearly visible?",
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_frame", "object_identity"],
            "relevant_entities": ["cut", "skin pad"],
            "observable_cues": ["visual features of the cut clearly presented to the camera"],
            "temporal_scope": "before_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "visually_observable",
            "current_support": "supported",
            "limitations": ["Requires optimal lighting and camera angle."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "postconditions": [
        {
          "requirement_id": "A4_POST1",
          "condition": "The examiner has evaluated the cut for redness, swelling, and leakage.",
          "source": "explicit_instruction",
          "source_reference": "Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.",
          "requires_expert_review": true,
          "vqa_question": "Has the user looked at the cut and is it free of redness, swelling, or leakage?",
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_frame"],
            "relevant_entities": ["cut"],
            "observable_cues": ["color of the cut area", "swelling profile", "presence of leakage fluid"],
            "temporal_scope": "after_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "partially_observable",
            "current_support": "partial",
            "limitations": ["Visual inspection cannot confirm the absence of leakage if it is not currently active, nor can it objectively differentiate pathological redness/swelling from normal appearance without expert baseline."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "error_criteria": [
        {
          "criterion_id": "A4_ERR1",
          "error_type": "technique_error",
          "violation_condition": "The user fails to inspect the cut thoroughly for all three indicators (redness, swelling, or leaking).",
          "compliance_condition": "Visual evidence shows the user focused on the wound area with sufficient duration and angle to inspect.",
          "compliance_question": "Does the user inspect the wound for all three specified conditions?",
          "applicability_condition": "A4 is performed.",
          "related_requirement_ids": ["A4_POST1"],
          "source": "explicit_instruction",
          "source_reference": "Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.",
          "requires_expert_review": true,
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_video"],
            "relevant_entities": ["cut"],
            "observable_cues": ["user gaze directed at the cut", "user pausing to inspect"],
            "temporal_scope": "during_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "partially_observable",
            "current_support": "unsupported",
            "limitations": ["System cannot verify inspection behavior without continuous video or gaze data."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "in_progress_criteria": ["The examiner's face or gaze is directed toward the skin pad.", "The examiner is stationary near the pad."],
      "skip_risk": "high",
      "skip_impact": "Infection or complications may go unnoticed if the wound assessment is skipped.",
      "review_notes": ["The instruction 'Look at' and 'Check that' are subjective clinical evaluations; the VLM can only describe current visual state (color, shape), not the clinical finding or the thoroughness of the examiner's cognitive check."]
    },
    {
      "action_id": "A5",
      "preconditions": [
        {
          "requirement_id": "A5_PRE1",
          "condition": "A non-stick pad is available to the user.",
          "source": "inferred",
          "source_reference": "Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut",
          "requires_expert_review": false,
          "vqa_question": "Is a non-stick pad available in the workspace?",
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["object_identity"],
            "relevant_entities": ["non-stick pad"],
            "observable_cues": ["visual appearance of the dressing material"],
            "temporal_scope": "before_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "visually_observable",
            "current_support": "supported",
            "limitations": ["Requires the object to be in the field of view."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "postconditions": [
        {
          "requirement_id": "A5_POST1",
          "condition": "The non-stick pad covers the entire cut on the skin pad.",
          "source": "explicit_instruction",
          "source_reference": "Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.",
          "requires_expert_review": false,
          "vqa_question": "Does the non-stick pad completely cover the cut on the skin pad?",
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_frame", "spatial_position"],
            "relevant_entities": ["non-stick pad", "cut", "skin pad"],
            "observable_cues": ["non-stick pad bounding box contains the cut bounding box"],
            "temporal_scope": "after_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "visually_observable",
            "current_support": "supported",
            "limitations": ["Occlusion may prevent verifying if the pad is centered or fully covering the cut underneath."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "error_criteria": [
        {
          "criterion_id": "A5_ERR1",
          "error_type": "spatial_error",
          "violation_condition": "The non-stick pad is applied such that part of the cut is exposed.",
          "compliance_condition": "The cut is entirely covered by the non-stick pad.",
          "compliance_question": "Is the entire cut covered by the non-stick pad?",
          "applicability_condition": "A5 is performed.",
          "related_requirement_ids": ["A5_POST1"],
          "source": "explicit_instruction",
          "source_reference": "Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut",
          "requires_expert_review": false,
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_frame", "spatial_position"],
            "relevant_entities": ["non-stick pad", "cut"],
            "observable_cues": ["cut edges visible outside the perimeter of the pad"],
            "temporal_scope": "after_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "visually_observable",
            "current_support": "supported",
            "limitations": ["None."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "in_progress_criteria": ["The user is holding the non-stick pad near the skin pad.", "The non-stick pad is approaching the target area."],
      "skip_risk": "medium",
      "skip_impact": "The cut remains exposed to environmental contaminants.",
      "review_notes": []
    },
    {
      "action_id": "A6",
      "preconditions": [
        {
          "requirement_id": "A6_PRE1",
          "condition": "The zip bag must be open to receive the pad wrapper.",
          "source": "inferred",
          "source_reference": "Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.",
          "requires_expert_review": false,
          "vqa_question": "Is the zip bag open?",
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_frame"],
            "relevant_entities": ["zip bag"],
            "observable_cues": ["bag opening visible"],
            "temporal_scope": "before_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "visually_observable",
            "current_support": "supported",
            "limitations": ["Difficult to verify if the zip bag is open if viewed from certain angles."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "postconditions": [
        {
          "requirement_id": "A6_POST1",
          "condition": "The pad wrapper is inside the zip bag and the bag is sealed.",
          "source": "explicit_instruction",
          "source_reference": "Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.",
          "requires_expert_review": false,
          "vqa_question": "Is the pad wrapper inside the zip bag and is the bag sealed?",
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_frame"],
            "relevant_entities": ["pad wrapper", "zip bag"],
            "observable_cues": ["wrapper inside bag boundaries", "seal closure line visible"],
            "temporal_scope": "after_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "visually_observable",
            "current_support": "supported",
            "limitations": ["Verification of 'sealed' status is limited by image resolution."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "error_criteria": [
        {
          "criterion_id": "A6_ERR1",
          "error_type": "spatial_error",
          "violation_condition": "The pad wrapper is not inside the zip bag or the bag remains unsealed.",
          "compliance_condition": "The pad wrapper is inside the bag and the seal line is engaged.",
          "compliance_question": "Is the pad wrapper fully inside the closed bag?",
          "applicability_condition": "A6 is performed.",
          "related_requirement_ids": ["A6_POST1"],
          "source": "explicit_instruction",
          "source_reference": "Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.",
          "requires_expert_review": false,
          "evidence_specification": {
            "evidence_types": ["rgb_frame"],
            "relevant_entities": ["pad wrapper", "zip bag"],
            "observable_cues": ["wrapper location relative to bag interior", "bag zip line alignment"],
            "temporal_scope": "after_action",
            "verification_method": "VLM",
            "observability": "visually_observable",
            "current_support": "supported",
            "limitations": ["Image resolution may not be sufficient to confirm a 'sealed' status versus just closed."]
          }
        }
      ],
      "in_progress_criteria": ["The user is moving the pad wrapper toward the zip bag.", "The zip bag is manipulated to be opened or closed."],
      "skip_risk": "medium",
      "skip_impact": "Waste disposal is incomplete, potentially leaving contaminated wrappers in the workspace.",
      "review_notes": []
    }
  ],
  "procedure_error_criteria": [],
  "review_notes": []
}
